_comment: Audited ported or compile-time-embedded third-party source/data in the inference revision consumed by SceneWorks. check-license-coverage.mjs requires this revision to match every inference Cargo pin, so an inference bump cannot land without explicitly re-auditing NOTICE, LICENSE-*, and production include_str!/include_bytes! sites. Dev-only fixtures and independently reimplemented algorithms are excluded.

artifacts.evidence: crates/audio/candle-audio-kokoro/src/g2p.rs includes cmudict.dict with include_str! in production.
Current inference main ports Cephes ndtri/erf/erfc and coefficient tables for Mage parity. It is disclosed ahead of the next SceneWorks inference pin that contains mlx-gen-mage.
